review_notes.detail: Source title prints DECODE 2ND LEVL CD 10000-10101. The original catalog filename had the incorrect six-digit range100000-101101; root corrected source and output filenames to the native five-digit range10000-10101 under the explicit human filename directive, preserving the original LEVEL wording. The filename-correction ledger records original names, scan order and hashes. OR and A function captions occupy block offset3; block banks remain standard.

C enable at r23 feeds first three OR gates, then c92 descends to r44 to feed the other three. D enable at r72 uses the corresponding lower returns, c92 descending to r89. Native focused shared upper/lower grid crops retain all explicit diamonds and unjoined crossings.
GG.B02✲ immediately turns upward after its pin text at c85 to r2, then right across the top. Output label is GG4, independently read from native right-side print.
Handwritten slash between ROSAR 5 and 6, circle at JJ, and checks/arrows near outputs are omitted. All printed stars retained. No damaged character required.
